defects.title: Courier New monospace font used across branding, navigation, headings, prices, and footer
evidence: S-001 dom: body > header > div fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > p fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > footer fontFamily=Courier New
S-002 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
S-003 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
defects.expected: Typography must be Inter or system sans-serif ONLY. Monospace fonts are explicitly prohibited (A1: 'tech-startup look, not fashion').
defects.actual: Logo, navigation links, hero heading h1, card prices, and footer are rendered with fontFamily=Courier New.

defects.title: SW/EN language toggle (button#lang-toggle) is missing from header
evidence: check:M1-S1-a
defects.expected: Header must include a SW/EN language toggle on the right (button#lang-toggle), visible across 375, 768, and 1280 viewports (A2).
defects.actual: check:M1-S1-a failed (0 matches for button#lang-toggle). The header contains only nav links 'WANAUME', 'WANAWAKE', and 'MPYA'.

defects.title: Header navigation links touch targets are under 44px minimum height
evidence: S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) height=15
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(2) height=15
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(3) height=15
defects.expected: Touch targets for interactive navigation elements must be ≥ 44×44 px.
defects.actual: Nav link anchors have a rendered height of only 15px (touch 68.06x15, 77.78x15, 38.89x15 TOO-SMALL).

defects.title: Text contrast ratio fails WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1
evidence: check:M1-S1-b
S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > p contrastRatio=3.92 LOW-CONTRAST
S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > h3 contrastRatio=3.92 LOW-CONTRAST
S-001 dom: body > header contrastRatio=4.31 LOW-CONTRAST
defects.expected: WCAG AA standard and milestone design tokens require text contrast >= 4.5:1 on background.
defects.actual: check:M1-S1-b failed with 13 text elements below 4.5:1 (crimson rgb(225, 29, 72) text against dark surface rgb(20, 20, 22) yields 3.92:1 contrast ratio; header text yields 4.31:1).
